title: Fontana Mix 2026: A chance-operations score generator for human-AI co-creative practice
description: A browser-based open-score instrument for human-AI co-creative practice, after John Cage's Fontana Mix (1958). Two eight-sided dice cast an I Ching hexagram, which deterministically produces a composite score: selections from three vocabulary sheets (Language, Image, Process), a compositional diagram governing placement, rotation and scale, generated mark fields, and a prompt directive for generative image synthesis. Built as the practice-based core of a cognitive-autoethnographic study of human-AI co-creation in neural painting, the instrument sets chance operations against the convergent tendencies of generative inference, a condition the project calls restricted indeterminacy. Because every cast is deterministic and timestamped, the transformation of creative intention between score directive and enacted response is preserved as a measurable record. The deposit includes the instrument as a single self-contained HTML file and the performance log of the documented test performance.
